ns2:section.sectionText: This Dance History seminar will take a critical look at African American male dancers on the American concert stage. In so doing, students should expect to unpack social assumptions regarding race, maleness, and gender performance. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours and 9 graduate hours. Prerequisite: DANC 240 or consent of instructor. This course satisfies the General Education Criteria for: Advanced Composition
